classification.difficultyReason: Requires the antiderivative of tan x, -ln|cos x|, and evaluating logs at exact trig values. Part b adds a sign decision because the region lies below the axis.

content.prompt: Find the area of the region shaded in each graph.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The region is bounded by the curve $y=\tan x$, the $x$-axis and the line $x=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The region is bounded by the curve $y=\tan x$, the $x$-axis and the line $x=-\frac{\pi}{4}$.

answer.worked:
The region lies below the $x$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}A&=-\int_{-\pi/4}^0\tan x\,dx\\&=-\left[-\ln(\cos x)\right]_{-\pi/4}^0\\&=\left[\ln(\cos x)\right]_{-\pi/4}^0\\&=\ln1-\ln\left(\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\right)\\&=\ln\sqrt2\\&=\frac12\ln2\text{ units}^2\end{align*}$$
